info.title: API.SH: willhaben
info.description: The willhaben API from API.SH: public willhaben data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
The willhaben marketplace categories with their ad counts, links and icons; with `category`, that category's sub-categories. Use an id with /willhaben/v1/search?category=.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/willhaben-categories

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: A category id: list its sub-categories.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One willhaben ad (marketplace, real estate or vehicles): price, description, attributes, photos, location, published and changed dates, shipping options (carrier, price, delivery days), vehicle equipment, category breadcrumbs, the seller's profile (`seller_profile`: type, display name, picture, member-since date, active ad count, user id, profile link and `rating`: average out of 5, number of ratings, typical reply time) and, for business sellers, the company details. Pass `id`, `url`, or `latest=1` with search params. Private sellers' phone numbers, email addresses and address are never returned (masked in ad text).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/willhaben-listing

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: willhaben ad id.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: willhaben ad url.

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: `1`: open the first current result of a search made with this route's search params (q, location and filters) instead of an id. Ads expire, so this keeps a link working.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search keywords (with latest=1).

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: State (with latest=1).

parameters.name: seller_type
parameters.description: With latest=1.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
willhaben (Austria) marketplace ads for a keyword (or, with `vertical`, rental and for-sale apartments and houses, used cars and motorbikes) with category, state, price, condition (`condition`), rooms (`rooms`), pickup or shipping (`delivery`), warranty and inspection sticker (vehicles) and other attribute filters, seller type, last 48 hours, buyer protection (pay and ship through the site) and sort: price, location, coordinates, published, changed and end dates, photos and attributes. `filters` lists every filter value with the param and value to pass back (`attribute_ids` for treeAttributes values, `category` for ATTRIBUTE_TREE values). Phone numbers and email addresses of private sellers are never returned (masked in ad text).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/willhaben-search

parameters.name: vertical
parameters.description: Site section to search: marktplatz (default, the marketplace), apartments_rent, apartments_buy, houses_rent, houses_buy, cars or motorbikes. Each section has its own `filters` (e.g. rooms, property type, make, fuel); pass them back through `filters`.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category id (ATTRIBUTE_TREE value from `filters`).

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Austrian state.

parameters.name: area_id
parameters.description: District area id (from `filters`).

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description: Minimum price (EUR).

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description: Maximum price (EUR).

parameters.name: area_min
parameters.description: Minimum living area in m² (real-estate verticals only).

parameters.name: area_max
parameters.description: Maximum living area in m² (real-estate verticals only).

parameters.name: year_min
parameters.description: Earliest first-registration year (cars and motorbikes only).

parameters.name: year_max
parameters.description: Latest first-registration year (cars and motorbikes only).

parameters.name: mileage_max
parameters.description: Maximum mileage in km (cars and motorbikes only).

parameters.name: attribute_ids
parameters.description: treeAttributes values from `filters` (condition, delivery, brand...), comma-separated.

parameters.name: seller_type
parameters.description: private or business.

parameters.name: last_48h
parameters.description: true: ads from the last 48 hours.

parameters.name: buyer_protection
parameters.description: true: ads with buyer protection and shipping.

parameters.name: rooms
parameters.description: Real-estate verticals: number of rooms, comma list of 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6-9 (e.g. `2,3`).

parameters.name: condition
parameters.description: Comma list. Marketplace: new, like_new, refurbished, used, defective, display_item. Cars and motorbikes: new, used, year_old, day_registration, classic, accident_damaged.

parameters.name: delivery
parameters.description: Marketplace: pickup (collection) or shipping offered.

parameters.name: warranty
parameters.description: Cars and motorbikes: only vehicles with a warranty.

parameters.name: inspection_sticker
parameters.description: Cars and motorbikes: only vehicles with a valid §57a inspection sticker.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Other site filters as param:value.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Results per page (max 90, default 30).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Results page, 1 for the first. Pass back `next_page`; null on the last page.

parameters.name: seller_id
parameters.description: Only this business seller's ads (seller.id of a listing).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A willhaben business seller's ads (same fields, filters, sort and paging as search) with the seller's name, address, phone, logo and website from its newest ad and its rating (`seller.rating`: average out of 5, number of ratings, typical reply time). Private sellers have no public seller page and are not returned.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/willhaben-seller

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The business seller's id (seller.id of a listing).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Only the seller's ads matching these words.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order, as in search.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
